fork.name: dragonpilot
fork.base: commaai/openpilot (v0.11.1 lineage, upstream base commit of 2026-06-04)
fork.description: Long-running community fork with a 'Less is More' philosophy: minimal, cleanly-isolated additions (the dragonpilot/ package, per-feature settings files auto-merged into params/UI) on top of a current commaai/openpilot base. Flagship feature is ALKA (always-on lane keeping gated by dual panda+openpilot safety checks); it adds adaptive longitudinal modes (ACM/AEM/APM), a phone web dashboard (dashy), multilingual UI, and per-brand quality-of-life toggles for Toyota/Honda/VAG, plus a fork-added MG car port. Targets comma 3/3X/four and community O3-class hardware.

features.name: Automated Lane Centering
features.description: Core openpilot lateral control: steers to keep the car centered in its lane whenever openpilot is engaged. Some cars cannot steer below a minimum speed (noted per car).

features.name: openpilot Longitudinal Control
features.description: openpilot controls gas and brake instead of the car's stock ACC. Standard on some cars; on many others it is alpha quality behind the 'openpilot Longitudinal Control (Alpha)' developer toggle, which is only available on non-release branches; on stock-ACC cars it is unavailable.

features.name: Experimental Mode (end-to-end)
features.description: End-to-end driving mode where the model handles stops, turns and traffic lights. Requires openpilot longitudinal control, so its availability follows the per-car oplong status.

features.name: Driver Monitoring
features.description: Camera-based driver attention monitoring with escalating alerts. Stock openpilot behavior; dragonpilot does not relax it.

features.name: Always-On Driver Monitoring
features.description: Stock toggle that keeps driver monitoring active even when openpilot is disengaged.

features.name: Lane Change Assist
features.description: Steers through a lane change when the driver signals and nudges the wheel. dragonpilot makes the minimum activation speed configurable (dp_lat_lca_speed, default 20 mph; 'Off' disables LCA entirely).

features.name: Stop and Go (resume from stop)
features.description: Automatically resumes from a full stop behind a lead car. Depends on the car's hardware; cars without it need a gas/resume tap (per-car status from the CARS.md 'Resume from stop' column).

features.name: Full-Speed-Range ACC
features.description: Whether stock ACC accelerates from any speed. Cars with a 'No ACC accel below X mph' limit are marked partial with the threshold.

features.name: Lane Departure Warnings
features.description: Stock toggle: warns when drifting over a lane line above 31 mph without a turn signal.

features.name: Driving Personality
features.description: Stock Aggressive/Standard/Relaxed follow-distance personality selector (dragonpilot exposes it in its own settings panel).

features.name: Disengage on Accelerator Pedal
features.description: Stock toggle: when enabled, pressing the gas pedal disengages openpilot; when disabled, openpilot stays engaged.

features.name: Record and Upload Microphone Audio
features.description: Stock toggle to record microphone audio with the drive logs.

features.name: Always-on Lane Keeping Assist (ALKA)
features.description: dragonpilot's flagship feature and its take on always-on lateral (equivalent to sunnypilot MADS / FrogPilot Always-On Lateral): lane keeping runs whenever ACC Main is ON, even without cruise engaged. Opt-in toggle (dp_lat_alka, default off), dual-gated in panda safety C (alka_allowed && ALT_EXP_ALKA && lkas_on && vehicle_moving) and in controlsd (gear, calibration, seatbelt, doors, steer-fault). Supported on Toyota/Lexus, Hyundai/Kia/Genesis, Honda/Acura, VW-group, Subaru, Mazda, Nissan and Ford brands; never weakens torque/angle limits.

features.name: dashy Web Dashboard
features.description: All-in-one phone-browser system hub served from the device (http://<device_ip>:5088): live Tesla-style visual/HUD, settings mirror, and system tools. serverd runs always; the onroad streamer (dashyd) is enabled by the dp_dev_dashy toggle.

features.name: Adaptive Coasting Mode
features.description: Reduces braking to allow smoother coasting when appropriate (e.g. slightly over cruise speed with no close lead), with emergency TTC/decel cutoffs that instantly restore full braking. Opt-in toggle; only affects the car when openpilot longitudinal is active.

features.name: Adaptive Experimental Mode
features.description: Automatically switches between ACC and Blended (Experimental/end-to-end) longitudinal based on driving context - dragonpilot's equivalent of sunnypilot DEC / FrogPilot CEM style conditional Experimental switching. Opt-in toggle; requires openpilot longitudinal.

features.name: Adaptive Personality Mode
features.description: Automatically forces the Aggressive driving personality below ~30 km/h and restores the user's selected personality above 40 km/h. Opt-in toggle; only meaningful with openpilot longitudinal.

features.name: Auto Lane Change
features.description: Nudgeless lane change: after signaling, openpilot starts the lane change automatically once a configurable delay elapses (dp_lat_lca_auto_sec, default off) - no steering-wheel nudge required.

features.name: Road Edge Detection
features.description: Blocks lane change assist when the model detects a road edge on that side, surfacing a 'Car Detected in Blindspot' style warning. Opt-in toggle.

features.name: Lane Position Offset
features.description: Fine-tunes where the car sits in the lane in centimeters (positive = left, negative = right), applied to the model's action in modeld.

features.name: Driving Model Selector
features.description: Selects among available driving models (dp_dev_model_selected / dp_dev_model_list), managed from device settings and dashy.

features.name: External Radar Support
features.description: Uses an external add-on radar (eFiniLan openpilot-ext-radar-addon) in place of the car's radar interface. Opt-in device toggle.

features.name: Toyota Stock Longitudinal Toggle
features.description: Lets Toyota/Lexus cars keep the factory ACC for gas/brake while openpilot still steers (dp_toyota_stock_lon). Only shown for the Toyota brand; useful on cars where openpilot longitudinal is the default.

features.name: Toyota TSS1 Stop-and-Go
features.description: Restores stop-and-go on Toyota Safety Sense 1.0 cars (the 19 mph minimum-ACC models), letting openpilot resume from a full stop without driver intervention. Opt-in toggle, Toyota brand only.

features.name: VAG A0-Platform Stop-and-Go
features.description: Restores stop-and-go on VW-group A0-platform cars (Polo, Fabia, Ibiza, T-Cross, etc.). Opt-in toggle, VW brand only.

features.name: VAG Avoid EPS Lockout
features.description: Scales steering torque down at low speeds on VW-group cars to avoid the EPS rack locking out openpilot steering. Opt-in toggle, VW brand only.

features.name: Honda Nidec Stock Longitudinal Toggle
features.description: Lets Honda Nidec-era cars use the factory ACC for gas/brake while openpilot keeps steering (dp_honda_nidec_stock_long). Honda brand only.

features.name: Toyota Door Auto Lock/Unlock
features.description: Auto-locks doors above 20 km/h and auto-unlocks when shifting to Park. Opt-in toggle, Toyota brand only.

features.name: Toyota Zorro Steering Sensor Support
features.description: Auto-detects an aftermarket Zorro Steering Sensor on Toyota and uses its higher-resolution steering angle for control (opendbc toyota/zss.py; its ALKA-specific hooks are currently commented out).

features.name: Rainbow Driving Path
features.description: Renders the driving path in animated rainbow colors, Tesla-style. Pure UI toggle.

features.name: Display Mode
features.description: Controls when the screen is on: stock behavior, on/off with ACC MAIN, or on/off with openpilot engagement.

features.name: Hide HUD Above Speed
features.description: Hides speed, max-speed and steering/DM icons once the car exceeds a set speed, to prevent screen burn-in.

features.name: Lead / Radar Stats Overlay
features.description: Displays lead-car and/or radar tracking-point statistics on the driving view (radar option depends on the vehicle model).

features.name: Multilingual UI
features.description: Live-switchable translations of the dragonpilot settings and alerts (tr() helper + dragonpilot_*.po files); the fork has always been maintained bilingually (Chinese/English) and more.

features.name: Auto Shutdown Timer
features.description: Powers the device off a configurable time after going offroad (dp_dev_auto_shutdown_in).

features.name: Audible Alert Mode
features.description: Selects stock sounds, warning-only sounds, or fully silent alerts (dp_dev_audible_alert_mode).

features.name: Buzzer Beep Alerts
features.description: Uses a hardware buzzer for audible alerts (beepd daemon). Only enabled on the community LITE/O3 hardware tier.

features.name: Right-Hand-Drive Mode
features.description: Makes openpilot obey right-hand traffic conventions with the driver on the right seat (dp_dev_is_rhd).

features.name: opview Telemetry Broadcast
features.description: Broadcasts telemetry to the companion opview Android app on an external display (enables stream encoder + webrtcd).

features.name: Tethering on Boot
features.description: Enables the device WiFi hotspot automatically at boot (dp_dev_tethering).

features.name: Disable comma connect
features.description: Turns off the comma connect/athena service for users who don't want uploads or tracking (dp_dev_disable_connect).

features.name: Delay loggerd Start
features.description: Delays the start of drive logging by a configurable time after going onroad, keeping the first moments of a trip (e.g. leaving home) out of the logs for location privacy.

features.name: Community O3 Hardware Support
features.description: Runs on community O3/O3L/O3XL hardware in addition to comma 3/3X/four, with a LITE hardware tier gating some items (buzzer, RHD helpers).
